allow: PowerShell($d = Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($d\) { Write-Output "DOCKER FOUND: $\($d.Source\)"; docker --version } else { Write-Output "DOCKER NOT INSTALLED" })

PowerShell($d = Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($d\) { Write-Output "DOCKER: $\($d.Source\)"; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}" } else { Write-Output "DOCKER NOT INSTALLED YET" })
